# Setup

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load core packages for the analysis session
library(here)
source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```


# Prepare features table
```{r}
# Gene expression
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered =  readRDS(file = here("tables", "dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered.rds"))

#Protein identity
alignments_human2mouse_all = readRDS(file = here("tables", "alignments_human2mouse_all.rds"))

#Distance
human_mouse_cds_distance = readRDS(file = here::here("tables", "human_mouse_cds_distance.rds"))

#Transcription factors
gene_tf_shared_unique = readRDS(file = here("tables", "gene_tf_shared_unique.rds"))

#BTMs annotation
btm_annotation_genes <- read_csv(here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv")) %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol = symbol, process, group, subgroup) %>% 
  distinct()

btm_annotation_genes_others = bind_rows(
  btm_annotation_genes,
  #Add non-BTM genes
  dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered %>% 
    select(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
    anti_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
                select(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
                distinct(),
              by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
    mutate(process = "Not-BTM",
           group = "Not-BTM",
           subgroup = "Not-BTM")
  )


btm_annotation_genes_wide = btm_annotation_genes_others %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group,
              values_from = n) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")


# CREs ===============
cres_type_homology_comparison_wide = 
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison_wide.rds"))
```



### Merge all features

```{r}
#Merge features (All parameters)
human_mouse_parameters_values = 
  #Annotate with CDS distance (Kimura)
  human_mouse_cds_distance %>% select(hgnc_symbol, dist_k80) %>% 
  #Annotate with AA identity %
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_all,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with BTMs 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes_wide,
             by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  #Annotate with TFs
  inner_join(gene_tf_shared_unique,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with CRES
  inner_join(cres_type_homology_comparison_wide,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  #Annotate with gene expression
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) 

human_mouse_parameters_values

#Save
human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_statsmodelling_parameters_values.rds"))

human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  glimpse()

```



# Statistical modelling

## Inputs
```{r}
#Create features tables for each model
input_features = human_mouse_parameters_values

human_mouse_features_regression = input_features %>% 
  select(-status) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(treatment:abs_log2fc_diff,inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, everything())

human_mouse_features_classification_legs = input_features %>% 
  drop_na(status) %>% 
  filter(status %in% c("Shared", "Not-shared")) %>% 
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(status, "Not-shared")) %>% 
  select(treatment:inverse_se_mouse, inverse_se_mouse, hgnc_symbol, status, everything()) %>% 
  select(!c(abs_log2fc_diff)) 

input_features
```

## Features dictionary
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)

feature_dictionary <- tibble::tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(human_mouse_parameters_values)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!feature_name_original %in% c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "status")) %>%
  
  # 1. Regex parsing
  tidyr::extract(
    col     = feature_name_original,
    into    = c("cre_metric", "cre_type", "cre_ctcf", "cre_homology"),
    regex   = "^(n_type|pct_match_type|n_ctcf|pct_match_ctcf|n_homology|pct_homology)_(PLS|pELS|dELS)(?:_(CTCF-bound|not-CTCF))?(?:_([A-Za-z0-9_]+))?$",
    remove  = FALSE
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    # --- Category Assignment ---
    feature_type = dplyr::case_when(
      feature_name_original %in% c("inverse_se_mouse", "abs_log2fc_diff") ~ "Gene expression",
      feature_name_original %in% c("dist_k80", "identity_human2mouse") ~ "Sequence evolution",
      stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "^(n_tf|pct_tf)") ~ "Transcription Factor",
      feature_name_original %in% c(
        "Not-BTM", "INNATE RESPONSE", "B CELLS", "T CELLS", "PLATELETS", 
        "ECM AND MIGRATION", "ENERGY METABOLISM", "MONOCYTES", 
        "CELL CYCLE", "IFN", "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "NK CELLS", "NEUTROPHILS"
      ) ~ "BTMs",
      feature_name_original == "n_total_cres_gene" ~ "CREs | Summary",
      
      !is.na(cre_type) & !is.na(cre_ctcf) ~ stringr::str_c("CREs | ", cre_type, ", ", cre_ctcf),
      !is.na(cre_type)                    ~ stringr::str_c("CREs | ", cre_type),
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    # Fallback assignment
    feature_type = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "PLS")  ~ "CREs | PLS",
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "pELS") ~ "CREs | pELS",
      is.na(feature_type) & stringr::str_detect(feature_name_original, "dELS") ~ "CREs | dELS",
      TRUE ~ feature_type
    ),
    
    # Limpeza preventiva: remove qualquer vírgula final caso tenha ficado em "CREs | PLS,"
    feature_type = stringr::str_remove(feature_type, ",$"),
    
    # --- Formatted Clean Feature Labels ---
    feature_name = dplyr::case_when(
      feature_name_original == "abs_log2fc_diff"        ~ "|ΔMean Log2FC|",
      feature_name_original == "inverse_se_mouse"        ~ "1/SE",
      feature_name_original == "identity_human2mouse"   ~ "%Protein AA identity",
      feature_name_original == "dist_k80"                ~ "Kimura distance",
      
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_unique"             ~ "nUnique TFs",
      feature_name_original == "pct_tf_unique"           ~ "%Unique TFs",
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_shared"             ~ "nShared TFs",
      feature_name_original == "pct_tf_shared"           ~ "%Shared TFs",
      feature_name_original == "n_tf_total"              ~ "nTotal TFs",
      
      feature_name_original == "n_total_cres_gene"      ~ "nTotal cCREs",
      
      cre_metric == "n_type"                             ~ "nCREs",
      cre_metric == "pct_match_type"                    ~ "%Matching Type",
      cre_metric == "n_ctcf"                             ~ "nSubtype CREs",
      cre_metric == "pct_match_ctcf"                    ~ "%Matching Subtype",
      
      cre_metric == "n_homology"                         ~ stringr::str_c("nHomology: ", stringr::str_replace_all(cre_homology, "_", " ")),
      cre_metric == "pct_homology"                       ~ stringr::str_c("%Homology: ", stringr::str_replace_all(cre_homology, "_", " ")),
      
      TRUE ~ feature_name_original
    )
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(feature_name_original, feature_type, feature_name) %>%
  
  # Relevel 
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_type = forcats::fct_relevel(
      feature_type, 
      "Gene expression", 
      "Sequence evolution", 
      "BTMs",
      "Transcription Factor", 
      "CREs | Summary",
      "CREs | PLS, ",             
      "CREs | PLS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | PLS, not-CTCF",
      "CREs | pELS, ",             
      "CREs | pELS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | pELS, not-CTCF",
      "CREs | dELS, ",             
      "CREs | dELS, CTCF-bound", 
      "CREs | dELS, not-CTCF",
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(feature_type)

feature_dictionary$feature_type %>% levels()
```



#Data exploration

## Correlation
```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=16}
library(Hmisc) # For fast pairwise correlation & p-value matrix computation

# 1. Prepare numeric data matrix
numeric_matrix <- human_mouse_parameters_values %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(where(~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 2. Compute Spearman correlations and p-values simultaneously
cor_results <- Hmisc::rcorr(numeric_matrix, type = "spearman")

# Extract correlation (r) and p-value (P) matrices
cor_r <- cor_results$r
cor_p <- cor_results$P

# 3. Reorder variables using Hierarchical Clustering
ord <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_r))$order
var_names <- colnames(cor_r)[ord]

# 4. Convert matrices to long format and apply FDR (BH) p-value adjustment
cor_long <- cor_r %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(var1 = rownames(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "spearman_rho") %>%
  inner_join(
    cor_p %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(var1 = rownames(.)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "p_value"),
    by = c("var1", "var2")
  ) %>%
  # Handle self-correlations (diagonal p-values are NA in rcorr)
  mutate(p_value = if_else(var1 == var2, 0, p_value)) %>%
  # Perform FDR correction across all pairwise tests
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  # Add significance stars
  mutate(
    p_signif = case_when(
      p_adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "" # Leave non-significant tiles blank (or use "ns")
    ),
    var1 = factor(var1, levels = var_names),
    var2 = factor(var2, levels = var_names)
  )

# 5. Join with feature_dictionary to attach category annotations
cor_long_annotated <- cor_long %>%
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = c("var1" = "feature_name_original")) %>%
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = c("var2" = "feature_name_original"), suffix = c("_var1", "_var2")) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_name_var1 = factor(feature_name_var1),
    feature_name_var2 = factor(feature_name_var2)
  )

# 6. Generate Plot with Significance Stars Layer
cor_long_annotated_matrixplot <- ggplot(
  cor_long_annotated, 
  aes(x = feature_name_var1, y = feature_name_var2, fill = spearman_rho)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  
  # ANNOTATION LAYER: Overlay significance stars
  geom_text(
    aes(label = p_signif),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 0.75 # Centers stars neatly within each tile
  ) +
  
  # Grid facets grouped by feature category
  facet_grid(
    feature_type_var2 ~ feature_type_var1, 
    scales = "free", 
    space = "free"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4cc9f0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#4361ee",
    midpoint = 0,
    limit = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman\nRho (ρ)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "",
    title = "Spearman Correlation Matrix with FDR-Adjusted Significance (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, angle = 0),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines")
  )

cor_long_annotated_matrixplot

cor_long_annotated_matrixplot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "statistical_modelling_features_matrixplot_all.png"),
         width = 16, height = 14)

```






# Modelling

## Classify Shared vs Not-Shared LEGs
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --------
# Load required core libraries
# --------
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(here)

# --------
# Step 1: Define Classification Recipe with Near-Zero Variance Filter
# --------

classification_recipe <- recipes::recipe(status ~ ., data = human_mouse_features_classification_legs) %>%
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, new_role = "id") %>%
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  # Filter near-zero variance predictors to prevent numerical matrix collapse
  recipes::step_nzv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_corr(recipes::all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())

# --------
# Step 2: Fit Penalized Logistic Regression Model (glmnet)
# --------
# Light Elastic Net penalty (penalty = 0.01) avoids exact 0/1 probability collapse
logistic_spec <- logistic_reg(penalty = 0.01, mixture = 0.5) %>%
  parsnip::set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  parsnip::set_mode("classification")

logistic_workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>%
  workflows::add_recipe(classification_recipe) %>%
  workflows::add_model(logistic_spec)

logistic_fit <- workflows::fit(logistic_workflow, data = human_mouse_features_classification_legs)

# --------
# Step 3: Extract Tidy Odds Ratios (OR) and Join Dictionary
# --------
logistic_coefficients <- broom::tidy(logistic_fit, penalty = 0.01) %>%
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature_name_original = stringr::str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", ""),
    estimate = exp(estimate)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    feature_dictionary,
    by = dplyr::join_by("feature_name_original")
  ) 

# --------
# Step 4: Compute Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) Safely
# --------
prob_df <- stats::predict(logistic_fit, new_data = human_mouse_features_classification_legs, type = "prob") %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(human_mouse_features_classification_legs %>% dplyr::select(status))

roc_obj_logistic <- pROC::roc(
  response  = prob_df$status,
  predictor = prob_df$.pred_Shared,
  levels    = c("Not_Shared", "Shared")
)

cat("Logistic AUC:", round(pROC::auc(roc_obj_logistic), 3), "\n")
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==========================================
# APPROACH 2: RANDOM FOREST CLASSIFIER (GINI IMPORTANCE)
# ==========================================

# --------
# Step 2B: Configure Random Forest Classifier (No Tuning/CV)
# --------
# Define Random Forest specification with fixed classification parameters
rf_cls_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry  = 8,       # Fixed number of predictors sampled at each split
  min_n = 5        # Fixed minimum node size
) %>%
  parsnip::set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
  parsnip::set_mode("classification")

# Assemble workflow with classification recipe
rf_cls_workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>%
  workflows::add_recipe(classification_recipe) %>%
  workflows::add_model(rf_cls_spec)

# --------
# Fit Random Forest Classifier directly on the full classification dataset
# --------
final_rf_cls_fit <- workflows::fit(
  rf_cls_workflow, 
  data = human_mouse_features_classification_legs
)

# Extract native ranger engine
rf_cls_engine <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(final_rf_cls_fit)

# --------
# Extract Gini Impurity feature importance metric
# --------
rf_cls_importance <- tibble::tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(rf_cls_engine$variable.importance),
  importance            = as.numeric(rf_cls_engine$variable.importance)
) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    feature_dictionary,
    by = dplyr::join_by("feature_name_original")
  )

# --------
# Save model artifacts and importance metrics
# --------
# Save
saveRDS(final_rf_cls_fit, file = here::here("tables", "final_rf_cls_fit.rds"))
saveRDS(rf_cls_importance, file = here::here("tables", "rf_cls_importance.rds"))
```

## Predict Log2FC Divergence Magnitude


### Model specifications
```{r}
library(mgcv)     # For GAM engine
library(vip)      # For Permutation Importance

# ==============================================================================
# 1. RECIPE DEFINITION
# ==============================================================================

regression_recipe <- recipes::recipe(abs_log2fc_diff ~ ., data = human_mouse_features_regression) %>%
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, new_role = "id") %>%
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())


# ==============================================================================
# 2. MODEL SPECIFICATIONS & FITTING
# ==============================================================================

# MODEL 1: Linear Regression (LM) ----------------------------------------------
linear_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

linear_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(linear_spec) %>%
  fit(data = human_mouse_features_regression)

linear_lm_engine <- extract_fit_engine(linear_fit)

linear_coefficients <- broom::tidy(linear_lm_engine, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
  mutate(feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", "")) %>% 
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))


# MODEL 2: Generalized Linear Model (GLM - Gamma / Log Link for skewed |Log2FC|)
# Note: For non-negative continuous outcomes like |ΔLog2FC|, Gamma GLM is ideal.
glm_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm", family = stats::Gamma(link = "log")) %>%
  set_mode("regression")

glm_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(glm_spec) %>%
  fit(data = human_mouse_features_regression)

glm_engine <- extract_fit_engine(glm_fit)

glm_coefficients <- broom::tidy(glm_engine, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
  mutate(feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", "")) %>% 
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))


# MODEL 3: Generalized Additive Model (GAM) ------------------------------------
# Uses mgcv to fit flexible non-linear smooth splines
# 1. Especificação do GAM
gam_spec <- gen_additive_mod() %>%
  set_engine("mgcv") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

# 2. Identificar preditores numéricos
numeric_vars <- human_mouse_features_regression %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric), -abs_log2fc_diff) %>%
  colnames()

# 3. Construir a fórmula envolvendo os nomes entre crases: s(`NOME_DA_VARIAVEL`)
gam_formula <- as.formula(
  paste0("abs_log2fc_diff ~ ", paste0("s(`", numeric_vars, "`)", collapse = " + "))
)

# 4. Ajustar o Workflow fornecendo a fórmula corrigida no add_model()
gam_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(gam_spec, formula = gam_formula) %>%
  fit(data = human_mouse_features_regression)

# 5. Extrair o motor nativo do mgcv
gam_engine <- extract_fit_engine(gam_fit)


# MODEL : Random Forest (RF) --------------------------------------------------
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry  = 8,       
  min_n = 5        
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(regression_recipe) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

final_rf_fit <- fit(rf_workflow, data = human_mouse_features_regression)
rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(final_rf_fit)

rf_importance <- tibble(
  feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
  importance            = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance)
) %>%
  inner_join(feature_dictionary, by = join_by("feature_name_original"))
```


### Model evaluation

```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=12}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. EVALUATION & MODEL COMPARISON METRICS
# ==============================================================================

eval_table <- human_mouse_features_regression %>%
  select(abs_log2fc_diff) %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(linear_fit, new_data = human_mouse_features_regression) %>% rename(pred_linear = .pred),
    predict(glm_fit, new_data = human_mouse_features_regression)    %>% rename(pred_glm = .pred),
    predict(final_rf_fit, new_data = human_mouse_features_regression) %>% rename(pred_rf = .pred)
  )

# Calculate RMSE and R2 across all 4 models
metrics_lm  <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_linear) %>% mutate(model = "Linear (LM)")
metrics_glm <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_glm)    %>% mutate(model = "GLM")
metrics_rf  <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)(eval_table, truth = abs_log2fc_diff, estimate = pred_rf)     %>% mutate(model = "Random Forest")

model_comparison_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_lm, metrics_glm, metrics_rf)
print(model_comparison_metrics)

# Preserve your exact factor level ordering logic
name_order <- rf_importance %>%
  arrange(importance) %>% 
  mutate(feature_name = fct_inorder(feature_name))
```

### Visualizations

#### Forest plot and Importance plot
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
# ==============================================================================
# 5. VISUALIZATIONS
# ==============================================================================

# 1. LM Forest Plot
linear_coefficients_forest_plot <- linear_coefficients %>%
  mutate(feature_name = factor(feature_name, levels = levels(name_order$feature_name))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = feature_name, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  facet_grid(feature_type ~ ., space = "free", scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.value <= 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#4DBBD5FF", "FALSE" = "gray60"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "p <= 0.05", "FALSE" = "p > 0.05")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y     = "Feature Predictor",
    color = "Significance",
    title = paste0("Linear Regression (R² = ", round(metrics_lm$ .estimate[metrics_lm$.metric == "rsq"], 3), ")")
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5))

# 2. GLM Forest Plot
glm_coefficients_forest_plot <- glm_coefficients %>%
  mutate(feature_name = factor(feature_name, levels = levels(name_order$feature_name))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = feature_name, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  facet_grid(feature_type ~ ., space = "free", scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.value <= 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#4DBBD5FF", "FALSE" = "gray60"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "p <= 0.05", "FALSE" = "p > 0.05")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y     = "Feature Predictor",
    color = "Significance",
    title = paste0("GLM (R² = ", round(metrics_glm$.estimate[metrics_glm$.metric == "rsq"], 3), ")")
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5))

# 3. Random Forest Gini Importance Plot
p_rf_importance <- rf_importance %>%
  mutate(feature_name = factor(feature_name, levels = levels(name_order$feature_name))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = importance + 1, y = feature_name, fill = feature_type)) +
  facet_grid(feature_type ~ ., space = "free", scales = "free_y") +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_all$blues) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 50, 100, 250, 1000),
    labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "1000")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Variable Importance (Gini)",
    y     = "Feature Predictor",
    fill  = "Feature Category",
    title = paste0("Random Forest (R² = ", round(metrics_rf$.estimate[metrics_rf$.metric == "rsq"], 3), ")")
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5))


# 4. Composite 3-Panel Plot (LM vs GLM vs RF)
(linear_coefficients_forest_plot + theme(strip.text.y = element_blank())) +
  p_rf_importance +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.5, 0.5), guides = "collect", axes = "collect")
```



#### Plot Observed vs Predicted values across models
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=3}

library(tune) # For coord_obs_pred()

# 1. Extract R² values dynamically for accurate facet labels
r2_lm  <- round(model_comparison_metrics$.estimate[model_comparison_metrics$model == "Linear (LM)" & model_comparison_metrics$.metric == "rsq"], 3)
r2_rf  <- round(model_comparison_metrics$.estimate[model_comparison_metrics$model == "Random Forest" & model_comparison_metrics$.metric == "rsq"], 3)

# 2. Reshape predictions and plot Observed vs. Predicted across all 4 models
p_obs_vs_pred <- eval_table %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(pred_linear, pred_rf),
    names_to  = "model_key",
    values_to = "predicted"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = case_when(
      model_key == "pred_linear" ~ paste0("Linear Model (R² = ", r2_lm, ")"),
      model_key == "pred_rf"     ~ paste0("Random Forest (R² = ", r2_rf, ")"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Relevel factors to preserve structural layout from linear to complex models
    model = factor(model, levels = c(
      paste0("Linear Model (R² = ", r2_lm, ")"),
      paste0("Random Forest (R² = ", r2_rf, ")")
    ))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_log2fc_diff, y = predicted)) +
  
  # Identity reference line (1:1 perfect prediction)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Scatter points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 1, color = "black") +
  
  # Linear calibration fit line per model
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, color = "#4DBBD5FF") +
  
  # 2x2 Facet grid layout
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 1) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  # Force 1:1 aspect ratio across axes
  tune::coord_obs_pred() +
  
  labs(
    x = expression("Observed Divergence (" * "|" * Delta * "Log"[2] * "FC|" * ")"),
    y = expression("Predicted Divergence (" * hat(Y) * ")"),
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted\nLog2FC Divergence"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

# Display Plot
print(p_obs_vs_pred)

```
